query: Configure a node to send a WhatsApp text message via Z-API. The phone number comes from $json.phone and the message from $json.message.
expected_behavior: PREFERS community node n8n-nodes-zapi.zApi if available
Shows community node config with resource='messages', operation='sendMessage', messageType='text'
Mentions credential type 'zApi' with id, token, and clientToken
Provides HTTP Request fallback with correct URL pattern
Mentions phone must be cleaned with .replace(/\D/g, '') before sending

baseline_without_skill.likely_response: May not know Z-API community node exists, would default to HTTP Request without knowing credential structure
baseline_without_skill.expected_quality: Low - would miss community node and proper credential setup

with_skill_expected.response_quality: High - prefers community node, provides fallback, includes auth best practices
